description: Multi-domain backlink overlap: given 2-4 domains, returns the domains that link to MORE THAN ONE of them, ranked by overlap (how many of the set they link) then authority. Answers 'who links my whole niche?' — the must-have publications, directories, and roundups your competitors all share. Domain-level only (no per-link URL/anchor). Free compares 2 domains, Pro up to 4; returns up to 25 rows free / 100 Pro.

domains.description: Root domains to intersect (2-4), e.g. ['a.com','b.com','c.com']. Free tier uses only the first 2.

name: common_linkers
title: Common linkers across domains
